parole.significato: the gemstones jet and obsidian or similar minerals
parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle Persian špk' (/⁠šabag⁠/), from šp (/⁠šab⁠/), from Old Persian 𐎧𐏁𐎱 (x-š-p /⁠xšapa⁠/), from Proto-Iranian *xšáfš, from Proto-Indo-Iranian *kšáps, from Proto-Indo-European *kʷséps.
From Middle Persian pstk' (pistag), if not via Aramaic (Jewish Babylonian Aramaic פיסתקא (pistəqā), פסתקא (pistəqā), Classical Syriac ܦܘܣܬܩܐ (pustəqā), ܦܷܣܬܩܐ (pestəqā)).
Borrowed from Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (nyck' /⁠nēzag⁠/), from Old Persian *naizakah. Compare Classical Syriac ܢܝܙܟܐ (nayzəḵā).
